welcome_message.title: Welcome to Emerge Kentucky Alumni
welcome_message.body: Here is a quick tour of the Home dashboard.

tour.title: Home dashboard
tour.body: Your Home tab is the command center for quick actions and updates.

tour.title: Community
tour.body: Visit group spaces and discussions in Community.

tour.title: Alumni Directory
tour.body: Find and connect with Emerge Kentucky alumni by cohort in the Alumni Directory.

tour.title: Events
tour.body: Open the calendar from here. The tile glows green when an event you're going to, volunteering at or saved is coming up this week.

tour.title: Messages
tour.body: Your direct messages with other alumnae live here, next to your profile photo.

post_tour_tip: You can replay this tour anytime from Settings > Info & tour.
revisit_instructions: Open Settings to revisit the info tab and start the tour again.
